item.title: Josie (Josephine) Murphy
item.description: Josie (Josephine) Murphy Drumleek South, Castleblayney, Co. Monaghan. Josie (Josephine) Murphy died peacefully on Friday, January 9th 2026, at Drumbear Nursing Home, Monaghan. Predeceased by her mother, Maggie; her father, Packie; brother, Tommy; and sister, Phyllis. Josie is deeply regretted and lovingly remembered by her brother Francie, extended family, neighbours, and friends. "May Josie ’s gentle soul rest in eternal peace." Josie will repose at Ward’s Funeral Home, Castleblayney (A75 NP30)

item.title: Funeral details announced of Ballinagh man who died in Australia
item.description: The funeral details have been announced of a Co Cavan man who died in Australia. 35 year old Sean Keaney from Ballinagh died near the Great Barrier Reef in Australia on New Year's Eve. Emergency services found his body in the water at Whitehaven Beach at 11am. Advertisement The Funeral Mass of the late Sean Keaney will take place this Wednesday, January 14th, in St Joseph`s Church, Drumkilly at 12noon. Burial afterwards in the local Cemetery. item.title: Cavan women in business continue to break barriers
item.description: Cavan Women in Business Network is a professional network supporting women in business across Co Cavan. An initiative of Local Enterprise Office Cavan, the network aims to connect, inspire, and empower women to grow their businesses, share expertise, and celebrate female entrepreneurship, locally, regionally, and nationally. The network was first established 13 years ago and since then has engaged with over 500 women across 26-30 business sectors and has over 75 members and counting. Advertiseme

item.title: Cavan student wins big at young scientist awards
item.description: A Co Cavan student has found huge success at this year’s Stripe Young Scientist Competition. Lewis Mohan from Breifne College was awarded outstanding 3rd earlier tonight placing in Chemistry, Physics and Maths. Lewis’s project, pHaulty Foundations, explores the impact of freshwater acidification on building materials such as limestone, sandstone, and concrete. Advertisement His research highlights the potential risks to heritage buildings and infrastructure exposed to polluted river environments

item.title: Co Monaghan twins triumph at young scientist awards

The Castleblayney College students built on last year’s success by taking home Senior Group, Biological & Ecological Category and the Intellectual Property Owners of Ireland Special Award.
